Automatic, manual steering and fitted front discs are kept distinct from standard/optional-equipment wording, which is inconsistent in the article. No stock-performance number, speculative 325-bhp estimate, tuning suggestion, revised rear anti-roll bar, weight or modern net/gross standard is imported. Other Duster engines, years, trim and related Demon/Dart Sport badge variants do not add counts.
cars.summary: The Duster 340 established Plymouth’s lightweight fastback compact-muscle formula, combining the 340 V8 with practical rear seating and a low-cost performance package. Its distinct Valiant-derived body and historical sporting role justify one original Duster family entry. The contemporary test praised its engine and transmission but reported severe understeer, heavy steering and highway hunting; significance is not a claim of excellent all-round handling.

cars.variant: Super Bee 383 Magnum four-speed — 1969 factory Scat Pack brochure
cars.specification_market: 1969 Dodge factory brochure, Coronet and Scat Pack spreads visually read. Selects the Super Bee 383 Magnum row, not the Dart 383 row, Coronet R/T 440, 426 Hemi or later A12 six-barrel package. Standard four-speed and drums remain distinct from optional automatic/discs. No axle ratio, Ramcharger option, performance measurement, production count or modern net/gross label is inferred. Other Coronet engines, bodies, colours and years do not add counts.
cars.summary: The Coronet Super Bee was Dodge’s dedicated no-frills Scat Pack muscle coupe, pairing the 383 Magnum with a standard four-speed, heavy-duty brakes and Rallye suspension. That purpose-built road-performance identity and established place in the muscle-car era justify one Coronet family entry. It is a distinct Coronet body/model programme from the Charger and Plymouth Road Runner, not another engine option or paint scheme for those records.
